name: Takanashi Karen
source:
A fastidious and headstrong young lady.
She has a glamorous and luxurious hairstyle.
She used to be the school’s No. 1 idol.
But these days she’s been overshadowed by Aoi and Shizuru.
Consequently, she can’t stand Shizuru—and especially Aoi.
She has a large entourage, but she also has stalkers.
As a sheltered young lady, she’s a neat freak and hates men.
She came to this school specifically because she hates men.
But she’s frustrated by the presence of an insolent guy (the protagonist).

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113190639if_/http://www.luchs.jp/psychs/reigaku/chara05.html]official site, archived[/url]]
